verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own RTX 5090 page states 32 GB of GDDR7, which covers capacity and memory type. The 512-bit bus width and 1.792 TB/s bandwidth appear only in independent reviews (TechPowerUp, Tom's Hardware), not in the first-party material in the pack, so the full spec set is not shown as vendor-published. missing for 10: first-party published bus width, first-party published memory bandwidth, a single official spec sheet covering all four memory specs
